editionMetadata: Mustafa Dib al-Bugha, Dar Ibn Kathir / al-Yamama, Beirut, third edition, 1407/1987, six volumes; from the digital header.
method: scripts/import-bukhari-jk.py classifies every raw source byte exactly once as front matter, section context, heading context or a numbered report span. It preserves original labels and all intervening paragraphs. A report span is a structural unit, not a certified complete narration.

limitations: A complete byte inventory is not a certification of Arabic transcription or narration completeness.
Section numbers and report labels belong to this edition; they are not a cross-edition reference map.
Heading context includes all intervening paragraphs. It is not silently folded into a report.
Upstream records a 2023 cleaning that removed editorial paratext and inconsistent heading annotation.

findings: Every one of the 5,524,762 source bytes is accounted for with contiguous hashed UTF-8 spans.
The 7,135 broad numeric markers comprise 7,129 report spans and six chapter headings using report syntax.

There are 7,124 distinct numeric report labels, four additional suffixed labels and a second occurrence of 3905. No absent numeric labels or empty heuristic bodies were detected; that does not establish text completeness.
The two 3905 occurrences contain distinct passages; printed-witness comparison relates them to separately labelled 4134 and 4135. Both raw records are retained.
JK 3906 includes a passage labelled separately as 4137 in the comparison witness. Report counts cannot be aligned by a constant numeric offset.
Upstream flags random characters and inconsistent heading continuation. Its cleaning removed editorial paratext; preserve the source as evidence and check boundaries before publishing any material.
The 2002 comparison witness has different numbering and is not the edition named in the digital header.
